status: PROPOSAL — requires RJ sign-off on repos+tasks+bands before any run

analyzer_grounding.note: Unsupported languages emit reuse_pct:null reason:unsupported-language (reuse_analyzer.py:512). Tree-sitter upgrade in-flight (async agent 2026-06-17 09:15, NOT merged to main as of this proposal). If it lands first, go/rust repos graduate to reuse_measured:true.

spend.protocol: Stage A dry-run (slugify+records) -> measured cost report -> RJ Stage-B approval -> Stage C full sweep under 600k fail-closed, 90k per-task kill.

interpretation_bands.reuse_median_scope: reuse_measured:true repos only (8: 5 JS + 3 Py; cobra+anyhow excluded). Median is over whichever measured repos survive wave-0 preflight.

GENERALIZES.distribution_guard: no measured repo < 0.20; >=4 of the 8 measured >= 0.40

MIXED.alt_trigger: bimodal: tiny-util repos high, sprawling repos low
MIXED.action: targeted work on the weak cell (likely large-repo symbol discovery) before features

CORE_GAP.alt_trigger: >=3 measured repos emit suspected_duplicates for the named target symbol
CORE_GAP.action: halt feature work; roadmap becomes 'make cold-repo reuse real'

interpretation_bands.verdict_rule: BOTH axes must clear for GENERALIZES; working-output gate can veto a high reuse median. A low result is a FINDING, not a failure; bands do not move post-result.

wave0_preflight.license_verify: confirm LICENSE file is MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD/ISC at the pinned SHA; on mismatch drop repo and use bench replacement
wave0_preflight.baseline_green: run the repo's own test/build command at pinned SHA on clean checkout; baseline MUST be green before any task; if red, drop + bench-replace
wave0_preflight.reuse_emit_check: for reuse_measured:true repos, confirm a reuse record with non-null reuse_pct emits on a no-op or dry diff

repos.why_probe: Tiny single-purpose util; clear internal slugify core + replacements map. Add-an-option task obviously extends the existing core.
repos.task_prompt: Add a preserveTrailingDash option to slugify that, when true, keeps a single trailing '-' in the output.

acceptance.working_output: npm test exits 0 AND added AVA case asserts slugify('foo-', {preserveTrailingDash:true}) === 'foo-'

repos.why_probe: Concurrency util; a variant task must reuse the existing iterator/concurrency machinery, not rewrite it.
repos.task_prompt: Add a pMapValues helper that maps over an object's values with the same concurrency control as pMap and returns a new object.

acceptance.working_output: npm test exits 0 AND added case: pMapValues({a:1,b:2}, async v=>v*2, {concurrency:1}) resolves {a:2,b:4}

repos.why_probe: Depends on string-width/ansi-styles; internal wordLengths/wrapWord helpers. Wrapping-option task reuses the existing tokenizer.
repos.task_prompt: Add a 'trim: false' option to wrap-ansi that preserves leading/trailing whitespace on each wrapped line.

acceptance.working_output: npm test exits 0 AND added case asserts whitespace preserved when {trim:false}

repos.why_probe: Record/RecordCollection/Database classes — textbook reuse target. Export-format task must call existing row access.
repos.task_prompt: Add a .as_csv() method to RecordCollection that serializes all rows to CSV using existing row access.

acceptance.working_output: pytest exits 0 AND added test: RecordCollection([...]).as_csv() returns header+rows

repos.why_probe: CacheController + BaseCache + adapters. Add-a-backend task subclasses BaseCache — extension is the correct solution.
repos.task_prompt: Add an in-memory LRU cache backend with a max-entries cap by subclassing the existing base cache.

acceptance.working_output: pytest exits 0 AND added test: LRU backend evicts past the cap and satisfies BaseCache get/set/delete

repos.why_probe: Lexer/Parser/TreeInterpreter/functions registry. Add-a-builtin task reuses the @signature decorator + function registry.
repos.task_prompt: Add a built-in to_upper function to the JMESPath function registry that uppercases a string argument.

acceptance.working_output: pytest exits 0 AND added case: search('to_upper(@)', 'abc') == 'ABC'

repos.why_probe: Canonical CLI; Command/Option/Argument classes. Deliberately SPRAWLING — tests reuse when the surface is large (contrast with tiny utils).
repos.task_prompt: Add a .requiredOption alias method .mandatoryOption that behaves identically and is documented as a synonym.

acceptance.working_output: npm test (Jest) exits 0 AND added test: .mandatoryOption('-x') enforces presence exactly like .requiredOption

repos.why_probe: Tiny linked-list queue exporting class Queue with enqueue/dequeue/clear. A peek/iterate-extension task must reuse the existing node/size internals, not re-implement the list.
repos.task_prompt: Add a peek() method to Queue that returns the value at the head without dequeuing, reusing the existing head-node tracking.

acceptance.working_output: npm test exits 0 AND added AVA case: a queue with enqueue('a'); enqueue('b'); peek()==='a' and size unchanged

_count_note: Exactly 10 repos in the array. Stacks: 5 JS (slugify, p-map, wrap-ansi, commander, yocto-queue), 3 Py (records, cachecontrol, jmespath), 1 Go (cobra), 1 Rust (anyhow). reuse_measured:true = 8 (the 5 JS + 3 Py) -> reuse-% median computed over these 8. working-output-only = 2 (cobra, anyhow) -> excluded from reuse median, counted in working-output rate over all 10. NOTE: interpretation_bands.reuse_median_scope text says '7' as a conservative floor; with yocto-queue promoted to the spine the measured set is 8 — the bands' median is computed over whatever reuse_measured:true repos survive wave-0 preflight (7 or 8). bench_replacements lists yocto-queue too; if it is in the running set it is NOT also a bench item.
